name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 5 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-05-14, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.69 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
